definitions.mismatch_X: abs(mean matched-random depth - bird median matched-random mean depth)
definitions.local_heterogeneity_H: max matched-random depth - min matched-random depth at the same event
definitions.experienced_deviation_Y: abs(used depth - bird median used depth)

interpretation: At the same degree of mean local hydrological mismatch, greater within-event local water-depth heterogeneity is associated with less displacement of the water-depth state actually used than expected under matched pseudo-use. This is compatible with local environmental heterogeneity providing behaviorally accessible buffering opportunity.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc mechanism decomposition of the Lake Erie dataset, not an independent confirmation.
Two matched random plots provide only a sparse proxy for local hydrological heterogeneity.
Random plots are availability samples, not locations proven to have been visited by the bird.
No coordinate-event join is used; geographic movement is not inferred.
The mismatch x heterogeneity interaction was not supported; do not claim that heterogeneity becomes disproportionately more valuable under extreme mismatch.
